capacity.description: (Optional) Messaging units for a Premium namespace (1, 2, 4, 8 or 16). Must be 0 for Basic/Standard.
capacity.title: Capacity

identity_ids.description: (Optional) A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs. Used when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: (Optional) The type of Managed Identity: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned or 'SystemAssigned, UserAssigned'. Leave null for no identity.
identity_type.title: Identity type

name.description: (Required) The name of the Service Bus namespace (globally unique). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

premium_messaging_partitions.description: (Optional) Number of messaging partitions for Premium (1, 2 or 4). Must be 0 for Basic/Standard.
premium_messaging_partitions.title: Premium messaging partitions

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

sku.description: (Optional) The SKU: Basic, Standard or Premium. Private endpoints require Premium.
sku.title: Sku

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags
